# Golden workspace

Reserved for legally usable known video/time/frame/annotation cases. No media
fixture or expected screenshot has been acquired or generated during setup.
A future fixture manifest must record origin/license, bytes/hash, duration,
known frame positions, expected annotations, tolerances and capture/build context.
Preserve original media; run experiments on copies under `work/`. Do not import
private videos or other projects' game fixtures. Root eval remains deferred.
